authorship: 本项目自行编写，允许公开；D01/D02/D07重述既有模型问题的最小事实。
frozen: 2026-10-02，首次调用模型前冻结；D用于诊断，H为独立复核，不删失败项。
allowed: 同义表达、自然语序、数字中英文写法转换可接受；事实、条件方向、频率、限定、重复次数及末句必须保留。

samples.source: The deposit is refundable only if the cancellation is received at least 14 days before the course begins.
facts: 收到取消而非寄出或提出
提前至少14天，不是14天以内

samples.source: Sending the form on June 1 is not enough. We must receive it by June 3, before the course starts on June 17.
Submit at most three files. Each file must be at least 2 MB and no more than 8 MB. Do not submit the original recording.
Do not stop taking the medicine unless your doctor tells you to stop. Take one tablet each day, not one tablet each time you feel pain.
作业迟交每天扣2分，不是每次扣2分。周末也计算在内，最多扣10分。
Among the 120 participants who completed both surveys, the average score increased by 3.5 points. This does not show that every participant improved.
facts: 只统计完成两问卷的120人

samples.source: Do not delete this repeated sentence. Do not delete this repeated sentence. The final total is 12,100 dollars, not 1,210 dollars.
请保留这句重复内容。请保留这句重复内容。延期申请已收到；尚未批准，不能把延期理解为扩建。
Only students who have not passed the first exam may retake it. Students who passed may not retake it, even if their score is below 80.
在2026年10月2日之前收到的申请适用旧费用；当天或之后收到的申请适用新费用。邮寄日期不决定费用。
facts: 看收到日期而非邮寄日期

samples.source: The temperature fell from minus 5 degrees to minus 12 degrees. It did not rise by 7 degrees.
The risk fell by 20 percent, from 10 percent to 8 percent. It did not fall by 20 percentage points.
至少提前14天收到取消通知才能退款，提前13天收到不能退款。寄出通知不等于收到通知。
Keep the backup until the new file has been verified. After verification, delete only the temporary copy; keep the original file.
只有完成两次测量的48名学生被纳入统计。中位数是72分，平均数是75分。这不代表所有学生都获得了75分。
Page 4: the deadline extension applies to the written report only. It does not extend the deadline for the oral presentation. The extension is two days.
facts: 延期只适用于书面报告

samples.source: 第一组每天检查一次，第二组每次操作之前检查。两组都不得在检查之前启动设备；检查后还必须记录时间。
If the test is negative, do not assume there is no infection. A negative result is not proof that treatment is unnecessary.
facts: 阴性不能证明无需治疗

samples.source:
Study notes, section 1. The team received 24 applications, but only 18 applicants completed the interview. The average waiting time among those 18 applicants was 6 days; it was not the average for all 24 applicants.

Study notes, section 2. The old file must be retained until the new copy is checked. Checking the new copy does not give permission to delete the original. Keep both copies if the check fails.

Study notes, section 3. The class meets twice each week. An absent student loses one point each day, not each meeting. The loss is capped at five points. Weekends count toward the daily total.

Study notes, section 4. Do not delete this repeated sentence. Do not delete this repeated sentence. The appendix lists the equipment that was not tested. Untested equipment is not known to be safe.

Final sentence: the remaining balance is exactly 317 dollars and must be received before July 9, not merely sent before that date.
facts: 每周2课每天扣1最多5含周末
末句余额317且7月9前收到不是寄出

samples.source:
研究说明第一段：一共收到60份问卷，其中只有45份完成全部问题。平均分为81分，只适用于这45份完整问卷，不能代表全部60份。

研究说明第二段：新副本通过检查之前必须保留原文件。检查失败时两个版本都要保留。通过检查也不意味着可以自动删除原文件。

研究说明第三段：第一组每天测量一次，第二组每次服药之前测量一次。不得在测量之前服药。测量后需要记录时间，但不需要记录姓名。

研究说明第四段：请保留重复句。请保留重复句。未测试的设备列在附录中；未测试不等于不安全，也不等于安全。

最后一句：余额为317美元，必须在7月9日之前收到，不能只在该日期之前寄出。
facts: 检查前原文件保留失败两版本
每天与每次服药前区别
先测后服记录时间不姓名
未测非安全或不安全结论

samples.source: A refund requires the office to receive your request no later than August 10. Posting it on August 10 does not meet the requirement if it arrives on August 11.
至少购买4张票才能获得折扣，最多购买6张。折扣不适用于儿童票，也不适用于当天购买的票。
facts: 儿童票和当天购买票均不适用

samples.source: Check the battery before every trip, not once a day. Do not charge it after a leak has been detected.
facts: 每次出行前不是每天一次

samples.source: 这80名完成随访的患者平均恢复了5天。这不是所有100名患者的平均值；20名未完成随访者未计入统计。
The sample was not heated. The sample was not heated. After cooling, weigh it twice. The final reading is 0.025 grams.
请勿合并重复的记录。请勿合并重复的记录。申请是已寄出但尚未收到，不是已收到但尚未批准。
Participants may leave only after submitting the second form. Submitting the first form is necessary but not sufficient. Keep the receipt for at least 30 days.
昨天温度从零下3度升到了零下1度，不是下降了2度。明天可能降温，但这还没有得到确认。

The monthly report covers 90 deliveries. Only 72 deliveries arrived before noon; the median delay for those 72 was 4 minutes. Do not apply that median to the other 18.

The laboratory must retain two copies until the review is finished. A failed review does not permit either copy to be deleted.

Read the safety note. Read the safety note. The valve must stay closed unless the engineer gives written permission to open it. Verbal permission is not enough.

Final instruction: record the remaining 46 milliliters after the second test, not before it.
facts: 阀门书面允许方开口头不够
末句第二测试后46毫升不是之前
